mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Stacked Deck</titleLeft><mainText>Twisted Fate deals bonus damage every 4 attacks.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Every 4 attacks, Twisted Fate deals bonus damage. In addition, his Attack Speed is increased.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <spellPassive>Passive:</spellPassive> Twisted Fate gains <attackSpeed>@AttackSpeedBonus@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed> and every 4th Attack deals an additional <magicDamage>@BonusDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Destiny</titleLeft><mainText>This character can be seen by all players.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate, which teleports Twisted Fate to any target location in 1.5 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Twisted Fate focuses on his cards, granting True Sight of all enemy champions on the map for @Effect1Amount@ seconds and allowing him to Recast.

Recast: Twisted Fate teleports up to @Effect4Amount@ units away.
Teleports Twisted Fate to target location in 1.5 seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Twisted Fate chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack, causing bonus effects.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Twisted Fate begins shuffling his deck, allowing him to Recast to lock in one of three cards and enhance his next Attack.
  • The Blue Card deals @BlueDamage@ magic damage and restores @Effect6Amount@ Mana.
  • The Red Card deals @RedDamage@ to nearby enemies and Slows by @Effect2Amount@% for 2.5 seconds.
  • The Gold Card deals @GoldDamage@ and Stuns for @Effect3Amount@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Twisted Fate begins shuffling his deck, allowing him to Recast to lock in one of three cards and enhance his next Attack.
  • The Blue Card deals @ttBlueDamage@ = (@BlueBase@ +@ttAD*100@% %i:scaleAD% +@ttBlueAP*100@%%i:scaleAP%) increased by %i:scaleCrit% up to @BlueCritMultiplier*100@% magic damage and restores @Effect6Amount@ Mana.
  • The Red Card deals @ttRedDamage@ = (@RedBase@ +@ttAD*100@% %i:scaleAD% +@ttRedAP*100@%%i:scaleAP%) increased by %i:scaleCrit% up to @RedCritMultiplier*100@% magic damage to nearby enemies and Slows by @Effect2Amount@% for 2.5 seconds.
  • The Gold Card deals @ttGoldDamage@ = (@GoldBase@ +@ttAD*100@% %i:scaleAD% +@ttGoldAP*100@%%i:scaleAP%) increased by %i:scaleCrit% up to @GoldCritMultiplier*100@% magic damage and Stuns for @Effect3Amount@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Upon killing a unit, Twisted Fate rolls his 'lucky' dice receiving 1 to 6 bonus gold.
Twisted Fate throws three cards, dealing damage to each enemy unit they pass through.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Twisted Fate throws three cards that deal <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> each.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Enemies can only be damaged by one of the cards.</rules>
